additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440351-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003627]Charging sessions didn't start CRM:02681000530
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannas,
Regarding the V2G logs, I noticed that the charger was waiting either for the customer to make a payment or for the OCPP to authorize the session:
[STATE - 2025-07-28T06:53:21.435Z] <response> AuthorizationRes ResponseCode=OK EVSEProcessing=Ongoing_WaitingForCustomerInteraction
However, after a timeout, neither a payment method was presented by the customer nor did the OCPP provide the green light.
Another session failed due to an unexpected transition from state C to B, seemingly triggered by the vehicle:
[STATE - 2025-07-28T06:55:11.842Z] PILOT State-C
[STATE - 2025-07-28T06:55:12.811Z] Subscribed value changed from 2 to 4
[STATE - 2025-07-28T06:55:17.078Z] Pilot measurement for C→B: length: 200, 0
We don’t have information on why the vehicle didn’t maintain pilot state C and instead reverted to cable check.
Do you know which vehicle was charging in this session? I noticed a successful session occurred shortly afterward—was the vehicle eventually able to charge?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
